text: {"lessons":["I should base each trade on a forward-looking view of risk, return, and portfolio balance—not on whether a position is above or below my average cost.","Selling winners early or holding everything through later gains does not show that either choice was right; I should use consistent decision criteria rather than infer skill from a short record.","Because prices are random and I check often, I should avoid trading merely in response to routine fluctuations and act only when my investment case or portfolio needs change."]}
